subject: Arlington Catholic Football Game
overview: Medford High School hosted Arlington Catholic in a varsity football contest. Arlington Catholic defeated Medford by a final score of 20-6.

items.title: First Quarter
items.summary: Arlington Catholic won the coin toss and received the opening kickoff, with both teams remaining scoreless through the opening period.

items.title: Second Quarter
items.summary: Arlington Catholic built a 14-0 lead following a touchdown run by Brady Cassidy and a touchdown pass to Jordan Nash after an onside kick recovery.

items.title: Halftime Intermission
items.summary: The Medford High School Marching Band performed during the halftime break.

items.title: Third Quarter
items.summary: Medford inserted Devin Brown at quarterback to move into Arlington Catholic territory, but penalties and a turnover stalled the drive.

items.title: Fourth Quarter
items.summary: Medford cut the deficit to 14-6 on a Devin Brown touchdown sneak, but Arlington Catholic answered with a Tyler Venezia touchdown run to seal a 20-6 victory.
